linked_or_non_linked.value: linked-base, non-participating, individual pure risk health rider; separate rider premium
linked_or_non_linked.quote: A Non-Participating, Linked, Individual, Pure Risk Health Rider

waiver_of_premium.value: Only the rider's own future premiums are waived, for the rest of the rider premium paying term, after an accidental total permanent disability. The base policy premium is not waived.
waiver_of_premium.quote: the rider premiums will be waived off for the remaining rider premium paying
waiver_of_premium.note: The waiver covers this rider only, so it is not a waiver of the ULIP premium.

waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.quote: The following benefits are available under each rider option:
waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.note: The rider gives OPD benefits, an ATPD lump sum and a waiver of its own premium on ATPD only.

waiver_on_death_or_illness_of_proposer.quote: The following benefits are available under each rider option:
waiver_on_death_or_illness_of_proposer.note: The rider gives OPD benefits, an ATPD lump sum and a waiver of its own premium on ATPD only.

critical_illness.note: The rider gives OPD benefits, an ATPD lump sum and a waiver of its own premium on ATPD only.

accidental_death.quote: The following benefits are available under each rider option:
accidental_death.note: The rider gives OPD benefits, an ATPD lump sum and a waiver of its own premium on ATPD only.

accidental_disability.value: Accidental total permanent disability: an additional lump sum, in each of the five rider options. Sum assured is 1.25 times the rider premium for single pay and 10 times for limited or regular pay.
accidental_disability.quote: an additional lump sum is paid to provide financial security

term_cover.quote: The following benefits are available under each rider option:
term_cover.note: The rider gives OPD benefits, an ATPD lump sum and a waiver of its own premium on ATPD only.

hospital_cash.value: Out-patient benefits only (doctor consultation, lab tests, pharmacy, gym, nutritionist, preventive check-up, dental); no hospital cash.
hospital_cash.note: Not a daily hospital cash benefit.

other.value: OPD benefits grouped as health, fitness and wellness, in five rider options: Prime, Pro, Ultra, Prestige, Optima. Pharmacy and dental only under Prestige and Optima.

rider_term.value: Single premium: 1 year. Limited premium: PPT + 1 year. Regular premium: 1 year for non-annual modes, 2 years for annual. Maximum 20 years, within the base policy term.

premium_paying_rules.value: Premium paying term 1 year minimum, at most equal to the rider term and consistent with the base policy. Modes follow the base policy. Rider premium is collected along with the base premium and guaranteed.

entry_age.value: 18 to 65 years or the base policy maximum, whichever is lower; maturity age 19 to 75

sum_assured_limits.value: ATPD sum assured: 1.25 times rider premium (single pay), 10 times (limited or regular pay).

premium_deduction.value: Separate rider premium collected with the base policy premium. Not deducted from the fund.
premium_deduction.quote: the rider premium as per the rider option chosen will be collected individually along with base policy premium
